method: Use four raw CAL phase row IDs explicitly matched to R37F3D2B positive-exposure mask; independent Tsys median support per dysh mean_tsys mode0 formula, effective harmonic exposure, Tsys weight and calibrated TA; native WCS independently from CRVAL1/CRPIX1/CDELT1; do not interpolate or pretend index-wise ON/OFF equals same physical frequency.
qualification: Even arithmetic PASS does not qualify W3 as physical common-grid natural detector control; fractional ON/OFF offset remains a separate physical modeling gate. No fill or resampling.
